description_full: Ryan Specialty Holdings, Inc. operates as a service provider of specialty products and solutions for insurance brokers, agents, and carriers in the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, rest of Europe, India, Singapore, and internationally. The company offers distribution, underwriting, product development, administration, and risk management services by acting as a wholesale broker and a managing underwriter or a program administrator with delegated authority from insurance carriers. It serves commercial, industrial, institutional, individual, and government sectors. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Chicago, Illinois.

financial_summary: Ryan Specialty Holdings, Inc. is a large-cap financial services business with a $12.1B market cap on $3.1B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +21% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Returns on capital run at 17% against a 7% cost of capital, a 10-point spread that creates value, though narrow enough that competitive pressure could close it.

The business throws off $641M in free cash flow — roughly 21 cents on every revenue dollar, which is the owner-earnings figure that actually belongs to shareholders, and cash conversion sits at 10.15× so those profits are backed by real cash.
On the balance sheet, debt is heavy at 6.3× net debt/EBITDA, and leverage like that is what turns a bad year into a permanent loss, and thin 2.5× interest coverage leaves no room for a bad year.
Shareholder yield is only 0.5%, a thin return of capital, and insiders hold 15% of the shares, so management thinks like owners because it is one — the strongest alignment there is.
